cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 87% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.63%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.28%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.54%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.54%, OKLO +6.78%, PWR +6.58%, EOSE +6.32%, VRT +6.27%. Laggards: DUK -0.97%, NEE -0.81%, ETR -0.56%, MPLX -0.19%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
